column1: Arithmetic Progression is list of numbers in which each term is obtained by adding a fixed number d to preceding term, except the first term. The fixed number d is called common difference. e.g.: 2,5,8,11,14,17 etc. where Common Difference (d) = 3.
Each item in AP is called Term.

A given list of numbers $a_1, a_2, a_3,...s, a_n$ is an AP if difference of $(a_2 - a_1), (a_3 - a_2), (a_4 - a_3), ...$ and so on give same value. I.e. if $(a_{k+1} - a_k)$ is same for different values of $k$.

column2: Mean of Even-Even Term or Odd-Odd Term (Mean of Mth and Nth Term where both M & N are even or odd)
Mean of Even - Odd term (Mean of Mth and Nth Term where one is even other is Odd)
